title: Adaptive Climate Configuration
description: Single source of truth for the Adaptive Climate container. Everything downstream is a pure function of this document: the helper/automation generator, the section scheduler, the analyser, and the UI. Learned data (almanacs) is NOT stored here - it lives in the almanac store and is regenerated nightly.

version.description: Schema version. Bumped only on breaking changes; the container migrates forward on load (app/config.py migrates version 1).

access_token.description: Long-lived access token. Held in a separate secrets file at runtime (chmod 600) and REDACTED from any config export or backup download. Present in this schema only so the shape is documented.

reconnect_backoff_seconds.description: WebSocket reconnect ladder. Final value repeats indefinitely.

temperature_unit.description: Display and storage unit. Everything internal is in this unit; conversion, if any, is a UI concern. Lux had no unit; temperature does, and it scales the reactive delta and maintenance step below.

heartbeat_interval_minutes.description: Observation cadence. A heartbeat is DEFERRED (not skipped) while a room's guard boolean is on, so it never samples a unit mid-transition.

reactive_window_seconds.description: After the first user-originated setpoint change, the container keeps collecting further changes for this long before writing one consolidated reactive event.

reactive_min_delta.description: A unit's setpoint only counts as genuinely changed if |after - before| exceeds this many degrees. Filters out rounding noise and transition echo.

sensor_stale_minutes.description: A sensor (or, for a virtual sensor, its unit) that Home Assistant last reported longer ago than this is treated as unavailable: no vote, no learning. Catches a sensor put away that keeps its last value without going unavailable.

control.description: The v2 cool-or-rest state machine. See docs/V2_DESIGN.md, Control.

boost_degrees.description: Boost cools at base + offset minus this many degrees (v1: system.max_step_degrees).

boost_max_minutes.description: Boost cap: after this long in boost the unit returns to cool at offset -1 (v1: system.correction_max_minutes).

cool_min_heartbeats.description: Minimum time in cool or boost, in heartbeats; met at (n - 0.5) x the heartbeat interval. A section change overrides it.

rest_min_heartbeats.description: Minimum time in rest, in heartbeats; met at (n - 0.5) x the heartbeat interval. A section change overrides it.

person_grace_minutes.description: After a person turns a unit on, no transition into boost or rest for this long. (A setpoint change is a vote, which forces a rest or boost instead.)

offset_cap.description: The section offset is capped at plus or minus this many whole steps; the boost step goes on top.

person_step_degrees.description: A person's vote moves each sensor's comfort reading toward its reading plus this (too cold) or minus it (too hot), at learning.reaction_rate.

trust.description: Calibration of the sensor trust model. See docs/TRUST_MODEL.md.

high_trust_deviation.description: Reaction deviation (degrees) that maps to maximum trust and the tightest comfort band.

low_trust_deviation.description: Reaction deviation (degrees) that maps to minimum trust and the widest comfort band. New sensors with no reactions start here.

data_dir.description: Container volume root. Contains csv/, db/, almanac/, config/.

csv_enabled.description: Write human-readable CSV alongside SQLite. SQLite is always rebuildable from CSV, so the container holds no irreplaceable state.

event_log_retention_days.description: Retention for the UI event log. Heartbeat and reactive history are never auto-pruned.

external_guards.description: Entity ids of input_booleans another system raises while it controls the thermostats. While any is on, setpoint changes are attributed to that system rather than the user. For coexistence during cutover; normally empty.

learning.description: Learning tuning; trust-specific knobs live under system.trust. v1's analysis_window_days, bootstrap_min_days, validity_delay_days and reactive_weight are gone: the v2 replay has no window, bootstrap or validity delay, and learns from reactions alone.

reaction_rate.description: Each setpoint-moving reaction moves the learned setpoint (and a comfort reading, from a vote or an accepted window) this fraction of the way toward what the person chose, and each reaction nudges each sensor's band this fraction of the way. (recency_half_life_days is gone: bands now move by reaction, not by a recency-weighted mean.)

outdoor.description: Outdoor input: it leans each sensor's trigger edges and can block cooling for a section. See docs/V2_DESIGN.md, Outdoor temperature.

source.description: 'forecast' reads weather_entity's hourly forecast at each section change; 'probe' reads probe_entity as a 30-minute rolling mean; 'none' means no lean and no block.

weather_entity.description: A weather.* entity with an hourly forecast. Required when source is 'forecast'.

probe_entity.description: An outdoor temperature sensor.* entity. Required when source is 'probe'.

block_mode.description: 'shadow' computes and logs the cooling block without applying it; 'active' applies it.

lean_per_degree.description: k: how far, in band widths per degree of (room comfort point - outdoor), the trigger edges lean.

initial_margin.description: Starting per-room block margin M in degrees: cooling is blocked for a section when its warmest forecast hour is at least M below the room comfort point (0: at or below it). It then learns from reactions, within 0 to 10.

schedule_profiles.description: Named time profiles. A room selects one by id; several rooms can share one.

id.description: Stable identifier. Load-bearing: every generated helper and automation is named from this, never from 'name'. Never change it once deployed.

name.description: Display name. Free text, changeable at will.

schedule_profile.description: Which schedule_profile this room follows, by id.

units.description: The AC units in this room, each an HA climate entity.

sensors.description: Temperature sensors in this room. Each learns its own comfort reading, band and trust.

presence_sensors.description: RESERVED. Optional occupancy sensors. Not yet used - reserved so occupancy can be added without a schema migration. See docs/DESIGN.md open decisions.

heat_sources.description: Entities such as heater plugs. While any is on, cooling is blocked for this room regardless of the forecast.

knobs.description: Household knobs assigned to this room; each drives every unit in it. Shape is a placeholder until the hardware is settled (docs/V2_DESIGN.md, phase 8).

scenes.description: Per-section auto/off matrix, keyed by section id. Absent sections default every unit to auto.

id.description: Stable per-unit id, used in almanac rows and generated references.

entity_id.description: The HA climate (thermostat) entity, e.g. climate.lounge_ac. Chosen from a live picker so a typo cannot resolve to 'unknown'.

leak_detection.description: Optional. When a sensor_entity_id is set, the generator wires the leak automation's trigger directly to it. Left blank, the generator emits a stub automation you wire your own sensor into by hand. Either way leak mode is a latch (see docs/DESIGN.md D6).

sensor_entity_id.description: The HA binary_sensor for this unit's leak/moisture detector, e.g. binary_sensor.baby_room_ac_leak. Chosen from a live picker. Optional - leave unset to wire the trigger manually in Home Assistant instead.

entity_id.description: For a physical sensor: the HA temperature sensor entity, e.g. sensor.lounge_temperature. Required unless source.type is set.

source.description: Optional. When set, this sensor's reading is derived from an attribute of another entity rather than a standalone sensor entity - e.g. an AC unit's own internal temperature. The trust model treats it identically to a physical sensor; only where the number is read from changes.

type.description: 'unit_attribute' reads the value from one of this room's own units.

unit_id.description: The id of a unit in this same room whose attribute this sensor reads.

attribute.description: The attribute to read from the unit's climate entity. Defaults to current_temperature.

id.description: Stable knob id, as carried by its ESPHome events.

scene.description: What one section does. Auto/off is per unit; a unit set 'off' is baked into the automation directly and holds from first deploy.

transition_seconds.description: How long the crossover takes to apply.

units.description: Keyed by unit id. 'auto' = follow the almanac; 'off' = force this unit off for this section.

sections.description: All six sections, in canonical order (sunrise -> sleep). Times should increase through the day.

id.description: Canonical section identifier. Fixed set - these six and only these six. These are SECTION names, not astronomical events: climate has no sun-relative triggers.

name.description: Display name. Free text; only id is load-bearing.

trigger.description: A fixed clock time. Climate has no sun-relative or composite triggers - it follows your routine, not the sun.
